assessments.condition: Remote-mode filenames must be relative and resolve inside EXCEL_FILES_PATH before workbook operations
prerequisites: SSE or streamable HTTP sets EXCEL_FILES_PATH; readable workbook outside that directory
assessments.rationale: Source review follows registered caller filenames through get_excel_path to cross-file workbook load/save sinks. Vulnerable remote launch globals do not contain absolute/traversal paths; fixed remote launches reject absolute paths and enforce realpath/commonpath. Retained fixed-source path candidates explicitly concern stdio, where no remote EXCEL_FILES_PATH policy applies. Current scan adds ten source-bound workbook/helper operations, including range read/copy/delete, load/save and parent mkdir. The three fixed/control parent-mkdir findings now explicitly retain the requested-path check for both remote launch modes. Source shows realpath/commonpath rejection before create_workbook_impl and startup creates EXCEL_FILES_PATH. A relative child has its parent in that directory; requesting the root itself reaches an existing ancestor mkdir and cannot save a workbook over the root directory. The remaining visible parent candidate does not assert an unchecked remote filename. Count it separately with its source-policy uncertainty, not as a bypass of the frozen filename condition. Its earlier unqualified report was conservatively false-alarm scored at 8bcaded and remains preserved. No finding is suppressed; no label/prerequisite or target source changed.
